primary.name: FORMED
primary.definition: composed-query held-out accuracy >= 0.5 sustained over 5 consecutive evals (eval every 500 steps)

FORMED_STRICT.definition: composed-query held-out accuracy >= 0.95 sustained over 5 consecutive evals

aux_generalisation.definition: min across forward-hop single-hop aux types held-out accuracy >= 0.95, sustained-over-5 rule

length_3_composition.definition: test-only depth-3 composition held-out accuracy >= 0.5, sustained-over-5 rule

1.1_paired_outcome_variables.sustained_over_5_rule: threshold must be met or exceeded at 5 consecutive eval points (every 500 steps); first eval to meet threshold begins the count; if met at step N, N+500, N+1000, N+1500, N+2000 -> FORMED at step N

1.2_directional_prediction.hypothesis: discordant pairs favour Arm R (R-forms/C-doesn't > C-forms/R-doesn't)
1.2_directional_prediction.test: McNemar exact binomial on discordant pairs, one-sided
1.2_directional_prediction.caveat: if total discordant pairs <= 5, report the raw 2x2 table with no significance test — the table IS the result

1.3_awkward_cell_adjudications.a: Arm R converges less often than Arm C on ANY outcome -> reported as 'role pressure raises task difficulty'; informative; not a failed experiment; no hyperparameter search in response
1.3_awkward_cell_adjudications.b: BOTH arms show role-operator structure under discriminator -> training-distribution hypothesis is wrong; structure is default at this scale/pipeline; reported as primary finding
1.3_awkward_cell_adjudications.c: NEITHER arm reaches FORMED on composed queries in >=3 checkpoints -> stop before any discriminator run; report; depth/scaffold questions reopen only by a separate decision; discriminator NEVER runs on a (checkpoint, arm) that did not reach FORMED
1.3_awkward_cell_adjudications.d: checkpoint fails FORMED in BOTH arms -> concordant-negative pair; stays in McNemar table; not replaced or rerun

1.4_discriminator_thresholds.status: TO BE CALIBRATED — freeze before first fine-tune completes (at or before step 500 eval)
1.4_discriminator_thresholds.calibration_source: existing Phase 7/9 organism activations OR freshly generated synthetic calibration data at d=128 — NOT any Track B activation

conditions.k3: port Phase 8C/9 battery with matched-regime shuffled-pair nulls at d=128

k4.reason: S4 synthetic-organism validation (design amendment 3) has not been run. Gate on that validation passing before any k=4 discriminator. Until then: recorded UNAVAILABLE — not improvised, not run uncalibrated.

1.4_discriminator_thresholds.frozen_rule: thresholds frozen to this config BEFORE first fine-tune reaches first eval (step 500). Thresholds computed from calibration data only. Once frozen, no post-hoc adjustment.

1.5_analysis_lock.primary: McNemar exact binomial on discordant pairs, FORMED, 12 pairs, one-sided
1.5_analysis_lock.exclusions: only episodes lost to verified infrastructure failure (declared, with logs)
1.5_analysis_lock.no_reruns: no per-arm reruns of unlucky seeds; the 12 checkpoints are final
1.5_analysis_lock.pair_definition: each verified pretrained checkpoint runs BOTH Arm R and Arm C training; the (R,C) outcome pair IS the matched pair

paired_arm_design.per_checkpoint: same pretrained weights fine-tuned under Arm R and Arm C independently
paired_arm_design.comparison: McNemar matched pairs — each checkpoint is its own control, initialisation variance cancels within pair

training.induction_pretraining: v2 corpus (Phase 5), full verification battery passed

arms.armR: role-rewarding — large pools, k mixed {3,4}, compositions at test longer than training, unseen permutation products
arms.armC: retrieval-sufficient — shared large-pool vocabulary base with retrieval-sufficient task structure; arms differ only in whether abstraction pays

verification.freeze_note: config + sha256 frozen before any GPU work
